name: Shourya Upadhyaya
headline: Backend-leaning full-stack developer
bio: I build production backends with Node.js, PostgreSQL/MongoDB and Redis, ship them in Docker, and monitor them with Prometheus + Grafana.

projects.name: OpenPumTa
projects.desc: Open-source study OS (habits, tasks, Pomodoro and AI daily reviews) with 300+ registered users, self-hosted with Docker Compose behind Nginx and monitored with Prometheus + Grafana.
projects.highlight: 30+ REST APIs, real-time Pomodoro sync over WebSockets, Redis-cached analytics.

projects.name: Moss X
projects.desc: E-commerce platform: I designed and built the whole backend and led 3 frontend/mobile developers from zero to real Razorpay payments.
projects.highlight: 20+ real payments with webhook verification and idempotency, zero duplicate charges; homepage under 50 ms.

projects.name: Cook Off 10.0
projects.desc: Competitive-coding portal with a custom CodeMirror 6 editor that served 1,000+ users during live rounds.
projects.highlight: Code is saved in three layers (Zustand, LocalStorage, MongoDB), so a refresh mid-contest loses nothing.

projects.name: Job Agent
projects.desc: Job-search assistant: pulls listings from official job-board APIs, scores them against multiple resumes, tracks applications and Gmail, and sends a daily briefing.
projects.highlight: In-process scheduler and Gemini scoring with template fallbacks.
